cohort: Two pregnant individuals (one 21-year-old G2A1, one primigravida) who experienced late presentation of acardiac twin (TRAP sequence) in monochorionic gestations, initially misdiagnosed as vanishing twin in the first trimester.
finding: Acardiac twins (TRAP sequence) can present late in gestation after an initial first-trimester diagnosis of vanishing twin, emphasizing the critical importance of early and dedicated ultrasound for accurate diagnosis and management to achieve better perinatal outcomes.
